title: Security Logs Cleared
description: Detects attempts to clear, delete or truncate Linux security logs and shell history to cover attacker tracks.
author: SOC Team
aql: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%LinuxServer%' AND (payload ILIKE '%rm -rf /var/log%' OR payload ILIKE '%rm -f /var/log%' OR payload ILIKE '%shred%' OR payload ILIKE '%bash_history%' OR payload ILIKE '%wtmp%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
